entries.zh: 俊秀：相貌英俊秀美；才貌出众
entries.en: virtue and wisdom (headword truncated, prob. sabiduría)
entries.notes: 西语词头截断疑为 sabiduría，M 栏第二声调 T99 污损；取'俊秀'才貌出众义以兼顾 virtud y sabiduría。

entries.zh: 应验；灵验（预言成真、祈祷或圣物显应）
entries.en: to come true, prove efficacious; miraculous power of a relic

entries.zh: 应验、感应（取'应'字）；'后'字连用义不明
entries.en: virtue; efficacious response; second character unclear
entries.notes: 'virtud. ides.' 后半难辨，M 栏含 T99 污损，'應后'二字连用无法确解，仅'應'与灵验感应义相合。

entries.en: fortune and virtue; blessed merit

entries.zh: 珠：痘疮之珠粒（天花痘点）
entries.en: smallpox; pustules like beads
entries.notes: M 栏含 [疑:hur/hun] 与两处 T99，仅'珠'与首音节可辨；痘疮义据西语 viruelas（天花）推断。

entries.en: scurf, ringworm; skin blotches
smallpox and measles

entries.zh: 水癣：湿癣，渗水糜烂之皮疹
entries.en: watery skin eruption; headword: smallpox and measles
entries.notes: 第二音节 [疑:lun/lou] 且 T99 污损；'水癣'取湿癣义，与词头 viruelas y sarampión 的对应存疑。

entries.en: virulent; festering spots of a sore
entries.notes: M 栏 'peng pan' 两声调均 T99 污损，汉栏单字'班（斑）'，据疮疡斑点义暂释，确解存疑。

entries.zh: 斑皮：皮肤生斑起疱、皮损
entries.en: spotted, scabby skin of a virulent sore

entries.zh: 癣迹：癣疮留下的斑痕、痕迹
entries.en: traces or scars of scurf; blotch marks
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆空，该行无可辨词目，无从释义。

entries.zh: 势：威势、权势（汉栏'勢/執'存疑）
entries.en: to visit ... (object word illegible in headword)
entries.notes: 西语 'Visitar al fugil' 之 'fugil' 难辨，汉栏 [疑:勢/執]，M 栏 T99 污损，与 visitar 语义不合，无法确解。

entries.en: to visit and speak with; speech
to visit suddenly, drop in; to inquire
to pay court to the king; attend an audience
to see, meet; to visit
to pay respects to the king; call on a superior
entries.notes: '參'与 Visitar el Rey（参见君长）义合，惟 M 栏声调 T99 污损，依约降为低置信。

entries.en: to inquire, question; to sound out (workers)
to inspect as an official visita; examine
entries.notes: '察'与西语 visita（巡查）义合，惟 M 栏声调 T99 污损，依约降为低置信。

entries.en: to survey, inspect, verify
entries.notes: M 栏后两音节 'utd yu' 难解且两处 T99，R 栏仅存 'lado'，据可辨之'勘（勘验）'立释。

entries.en: to visit the sick, or ... (headword truncated)
entries.notes: 西语词头截断 san[残]（疑为 sanar 或 santiguar），H'望'取探望义，M 栏 T99 污损。
